versions.content: } If the API ComM_EcuM_WakeUpIndication() is called in PNC state COMM_PNC_NO_COMMUNICATION, and the configuration switch ComMSynchronousWakeUp is set to TRUE (see ECUC_ComM_00695), the PNC main state COMM_PNC_NO_COMMUNICATION shall be left and the PNC sub state COMM_PNC_PREPARE_SLEEP shall be entered.

If the API ComM_EcuM_WakeUpIndication() is called in PNC state COMM_PNC_NO_COMMUNICATION, the configuration switch ComMSynchronousWakeUp is set to TRUE (see ECUC_ComM_00695) and for all PNCs that reference at least one ComMChannel via ComMChannelPerPnc (see [ECUC_ComM_00880]), the PNC main state COMM_PNC_NO_COMMUNICATION shall be left and the PNC sub state COMM_PNC_PREPARE_SLEEP shall be entered.

If the API ComM_EcuM_WakeUpIndication() is called in PNC state COMM_PNC_NO_- COMMUNICATION, the configuration switch ComMSynchronousWakeUp is set to TRUE (see [ECUC_ComM_00695]) and for all PNCs that reference at least one ComMChan- nel via ComMChannelPerPnc (see [ECUC_ComM_00880]), the PNC main state COMM_PNC_NO_COMMUNICATION shall be left and the PNC sub state COMM_PNC_- PREPARE_SLEEP shall be entered.
